name: Seamless Digital Holdings Limited
note: UK private limited company (Companies House no. 14628781, incorporated 31 January 2023, Towcester, Northamptonshire). Its PSC register names Mr Mark Antony Castro Turner and Mr Robert Rodrigues Decastro Turner, each with more than 25% but not more than 50% of shares and voting rights; no other PSC. Holds 75% or more of Seamless Digital Ltd (no. 13846251), the company behind the Seamless Digital brand (seamlessdigital.com; founder and CEO Mark Turner; a spin-off from Silverstone Paint Technology).
